text: Because, if you look closely, India keeps living the same story.
First, someone stitches the land together, then it shines, the richest place on Earth.
Outsiders march in to take it.
The invaders end up eating its food, speaking its languages, and building its monuments.
Stitch. Shine. Shatter. Absorb. Again and again.
So how did one land become the richest place in the world, lose it all, and start climbing back?
Hold on to something. Let's go back to the very beginning.
